cases.about: Her obituary said, "Precious was educated in the Piscataway, NJ at the Piscataway Vo-Tech School. She was employed a C.N.A. for 4 years at different locations. She also worked in security for 5 years. Precious was raised up in the Macedonia Free Will Baptist Church in Piscataway, NJ. Precious was the highlight of a party. She was an outgoing person, besides working. She loves kids. Always has a smile on her face and a loving heart. She always reaching out to help people, especially young girls. Precious loved to cook and bake.  She also loves to travel and do vacations with her sister/cousin. Precious was a loving woman full of happiness and peace. She will truly be missed although we know God loves her, and so do we."

cases.name: Stephanie Jasmine Diana ViI
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Successfully, Stephanie obtained education throughout the Mercer County public school systems. Stephanie graduated from Trenton Central Highschool in 2006, where she studied within the Medical Arts Academy. She then proceeded to study some medical courses at Berkeley College. Stephanie was a hard worker, as she was diligently working to obtain her Nursing degree at Prism Career Institute. The Nursing world had no idea what a delight it would be to be cared for at the hands and heart of Stephanie.
 
Stephanie was blessed with a large and loving family; as well as Friends who loved her equally as family. A mother, daughter, sister, niece, cousin, and friend like you is rare. To know Stephanie is to know what genuine love feels like, to understand the dynamics of unmatched loyalty, and to always be fueled by determination. Stephanie’s persona was so magical that before she physically entered a room, her spirit was already felt. She has always been admired for her contagious laugh and vivacious energy. If you were to ask Stephanie what her greatest accomplishments were,
gracefully at ease she ’d respond with a smile “My kids.” A woman of dignity, style and grace, and charm, Stephanie was one of those people that you met, but would never forget; it was impossible to do so. One of her greatest passions was helping others and the reward she would receive would always be seeing those that she helped in a state of happiness.
 
Stephanie has always excelled tremendously towards any goal(s) that she set forth for herself and overall, her determination was adamant and admirable. She was a devoted mother to two beautiful children. Talil and Ja’Lani. Stephanie was well liked and respected throughout her community. Stephanie’s presence was a present and having the opportunity to experience her in any capacity was an unforgettable blessing. Stephanie loved to laugh and crack jokes, dancing, listening to music, traveling, and shopping for the newest fashions. She enjoyed making great memories and spending time with her loved ones. Stephanie loved to eat and was a great cook. She also had an overall passion for cleaning.
 
Stephanie was raised by her aunt, Trina Hill. Aunt Trina instilled in Stephanie to always be the best at all that she indulged in. Stephanie’s relationship with Aunt Trina was one of akin(i as she always spoke in high regard of her auntie . She excitedly grew up with a very close knitted relationship as cousins, more like sisters with Erica and Lahsharon. There’s not a day that goes by, that Stephanie will not be missed."
